user_saw: An MCP server's tools could be missing from a new session or cron run if its first tool listing took more than 1.5 seconds and no request timeout was configured.
summary: The fix raises the default MCP catalog listing timeout from 1.5 seconds to 10 seconds when no explicit request timeout is configured.
reasoning: I verified that the fix's parent used the 1.5-second fallback for servers without an explicit request timeout. The fix description attributes the cap to PR #85063, but the local path history stopped at the July 1 graft because an older object was missing. I could not inspect that PR's diff or verify whether slow listings had worked before it.
